findings.title: Cross-role duplicate image bytes were accepted
findings.observed_before: 384000 manifest rows contained 383887 unique image SHA-256 values and 76 cross-scientific-role groups
findings.resolution: Frozen SHA-level exclusions, content-unique T, and fail-closed role filtering

findings.title: Materialized training images were not byte-bound
findings.observed_before: basename and label could accept same-name same-label wrong image bytes
findings.resolution: Every materialized image is checked against registered path, label, byte count, and SHA-256

findings.title: Endpoint could evaluate a different hard-coded dataset root
findings.observed_before: E200 endpoint did not bind the trainer-selected validated dataset root
findings.resolution: Endpoint receives, validates, records, and uses the same explicit dataset root

findings.title: Different tokens could simultaneously claim one logical job
findings.resolution: Logical-job digest, serialized fence generations, heartbeat lease, and publish-time fence validation

findings.title: Completion could be published before endpoint and final artifact index
findings.observed_before: FORMAL_BRANCH_COMPLETE could survive a later endpoint failure and block resume
findings.resolution: Pending states plus one atomic canonical completion receipt after endpoint/index validation

findings.title: No current 13-machine deployment plan existed
findings.observed_before: No v4 mapping for 22 parents and 176 branches across 13 RTX 3090 machines
findings.resolution: Deterministic seeded random waves over 12 active machine IDs plus one unused buffer; no GPU UUID or file lock by owner decision

findings.title: Registered CSV and evidence hashes depended on line-ending conversion
findings.observed_before: GitHub LF archive bytes differed from Windows CRLF evidence identities
findings.resolution: Path-specific LF policy with manifests rebound to canonical Git blobs

findings.title: uv isolated temporary interpreter path polluted source and checkpoint identity
findings.observed_before: Same code and seed produced different source-tree and parent checkpoint SHA solely from changing .tmp interpreter parent directory
findings.resolution: Interpreter identity uses stable executable name plus implementation/version/runtime dependency identity
